name: Purple Dragon Rook
description: Origin Feat You gain the following benefits. Once you use this benefit, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Entreat
features.description: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills: Insight, Performance, or Persuasion.

features.name: Rallying Cry
features.description: When you roll Initiative and don’t have the Incapacitated condition, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus that you can see within 30 feet of yourself. Those creatures gain Heroic Inspiration.
